description: Check O-status-config-copy by observing ApplyConfChange and immediate Status on three real nodes after message-driven commitment. Use explicit-joint false and implicit-joint true policies, with subsequent automatic exit observations retained.

harness.description: Public RawNode mutation API and real three-node Ready/Advance loop; serialized paired configuration outputs before Advance.
semantic_changes: MemoryStorage represents crash-free persistence with writes completed before outbound messages.
Read-only live flag diagnostic; no protocol mutation or substituted peer acknowledgments.

legality.derivation: The driver initializes empty stores with Bootstrap, applies all bootstrap entries, campaigns and replicates a remove-3 configuration proposal. Only actual CommittedEntries are applied, with contiguous index checks. Persistence precedes releasing messages, and Advance follows application and observation. No transfer or message loss is enabled in this driver. Every Ready/network queue is drained; RawNode has no background resources to stop.
legality.applicability: Crash-free synchronous storage, serialized calls and no concurrent mutations.

grounding.derivation: The immediate ApplyConfChange return is a ConfState from the newly installed tracker, including AutoLeave. No mutation occurs between that return and RawNode.Status. The returned status copy must describe the same configuration policy; explicit-joint false is a permitted control. Comparison is between two actual public outputs. A private live flag is reported only as a diagnostic to separate export loss from original mutation.
grounding.applicability: Serialized live RawNode with a real committed configuration entry. Identity is case, node and log index; every emitted copy result is checked, including implicit entry, explicit control and any subsequent actual exit entry.
alternatives: Maps may be copied correctly while a scalar is omitted; membership_equal is diagnostic, not an outcome filter.

observable_properties.description: A status copy preserves the installed configuration AutoLeave value at the same serialized observation point.

uncertainties: No claim about external consumers or live protocol corruption.
